_help: Act 4, dawn after the attack. The surviving leader proposes working together below (they insist on two chambers of their own choosing). Accepting sets ally to americans / germans; refusing or nobody left sets ally to an empty string. Start it with the surviving leader's Npc (or Eleanor / any node when nobody survived).

whitfield_offer.speaker: whitfield
whitfield_offer.line: I owe you my hide, and Charlie Whitfield pays his debts. Let's go below together: your people, my people, my equipment. One condition: when we get down there, I pick two of the chambers. Deal?

choices.label: Turn him down
choices.line: Thanks, Whitfield, but we'll go down on our own.

whitfield_yes.speaker: whitfield
whitfield_yes.line: Ha! Now we're cooking. I'll have Red split up the rifles.

whitfield_no.speaker: whitfield
whitfield_no.line: Suit yourself, pal. The offer stands if you change your mind.

adler_offer.speaker: adler
adler_offer.line: Without you we would all be dead. I propose that we combine our resources for the next level: our records, your people. I must insist on two chambers for our own study, chosen on scholarly grounds.

choices.label: Agree
choices.line: Agreed, Professor. Two chambers, and we share what we find.

choices.label: Decline
choices.line: With respect, Professor, we'll work alone.

adler_yes.speaker: adler
adler_yes.line: Good. Wilhelm will bring you copies of everything we have recorded so far.

adler_no.speaker: adler
adler_no.line: As you wish. I hope you will not regret it.

both.speaker: player
both.line: Both camps are still standing. Whitfield and Adler each want to join us below, and neither will work with the other.

choices.label: Join the Americans
choices.line: Whitfield's offer. His equipment, his two chambers.

choices.label: Join the Germans
choices.line: Adler's offer. His records, his two chambers.

choices.label: Go alone
choices.line: Neither. We go down by ourselves.

grim_eleanor.speaker: eleanor
grim_eleanor.line: There's nobody left at either camp. Nobody to bury them but us.

grim_alone.speaker: player
grim_alone.line: Both camps are silent. Whatever's below, we face it alone now.
